newsitem.title: ETHIOPIA: AIDS suspect stoned to death in Ethiopia.
newsitem.headline: AIDS suspect stoned to death in Ethiopia.

text.p: Residents stoned to death an emaciated man travelling in Ethiopia's northern Gojam region because they suspected he carried AIDS, the state news agency said on Monday.
The Ethiopian News Agency quoted police as saying Andarge Zwede was denounced by a hysterical woman, who with the help of four men and two other women then stoned him to death.
The alleged killers were arrested. It gave no date for the killing.
